text: Olant and Potumkin are confined in a cage with enchanted\nchains at the Halloween Castle. Collect information about\nhow to cut the chains at El Scaro!
Filecia told us about the materials of Shamhna Powder.\nCollect them to dispel the magic on the chains and\nrelease Olant and Potumkin!
Pumpking is eager to avenge themselves on the witch.\nCollect the sweets for them!
Finally Jeila the Witch showed herself!\nDefeat her with Pumpking!
[[N]]Collect information at the blacksmith's in El Scaro.
[[N]]Get materials of Shamhna Powder and deliver them to Jacky.
